limits: A count guard verifies cardinality, not that every possible behavioral branch is reached.
A case-array gap is a missing future omission guard; it does not mean the observed cases failed or were absent.
Suites emitting only qualitative success labels have no declared numeric assertion total; this is not a claim that all37now have checkpoint counters.
Unit-runner totals are reported by Node/unittest, not fixed cardinality contracts; unit totals can grow.
